questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

45 * 9 * 3 * 7 * 5 * 21
questions.solution:
Explanation :

BODMAS table

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

 Given equation : 45*9*3*7*5*21

**Option 1 : ÷, +, × , -, = **by subsituting values by BODMAS rule we get

 
• **45 ÷ 9 **+ 3 × 7 - 5 = 21
 
• 5 + 3 × 7 - 5 = 21
 
• **5 + 21** - 5 = 21
 
• 26 - 5 = 21
 
• **21 = 21 ( LHS = RHS )**

Option 2. : -, ÷, +, × , = by subsituting values by BODMAS rule we get

 
• 45 - **9 ÷ 3** + 7 × 5 = 21
 
• 45 - 3 +** 7 × 5** = 21
 
• **45** - 3 + **35 **= 21
 
• **80 - 3** = 21
 
• 77 ≠ 21(LHS ≠ RHS )

Option 3 : × , +, ÷, -, = by subsituting values by BODMAS rule we get

 
• 45 × 9 + **3 ÷ 7** - 5 = 21
 
• **405 + 0.42** - 5 = 21
 
• **405.42 - 5 **= 21
 
• 400.42 ≠ 51(LHS ≠ RHS )

Option 4 : -, +, × , ÷, = by subsituting values by BODMAS rule we get

 
• 45 - 9 + 3 ×** 7 ÷ 5 **= 21
 
• 45 - 9 + **3 ×**** 1.4** = 21
 
• **45 **- 9 +** 4.2** = 21
 
• 49.2 - 9 = 21
 
• 40.2 ≠ 21(LHS ≠ RHS )

Hence, **"÷, +, × , -, =" ** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row: 124, 38, 100

Second row: 78, 25, 64

Third row: 94, 31, ?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the number into its constituent digits. For example, 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is 

First Row: 124 ÷ 2 + 38 = 62 + 38 = 100

Second Row: 78 ÷ 2 + 25 = 39 + 25 = 64

**Third row: 94 ÷ 2 + 31 = 47 + 31 = 78**

Hence, **78 **is the** correct answer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** (3rd number - 2nd number) × 2 = 1st number

Now,

First row: 124, 38, 100 ⇒ (100 - 38) × 2 = 62 × 2 = 124.

Second row: 78, 25, 64 ⇒ (64 - 25) × 2 = 39 × 2 = 78.

Third row: 94, 31, ? ⇒ (78 - 31) × 2 = 47 × 2 = 94.

Hence, 78 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(31, 26, 155)

(18, 12, 108)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed.)
questions.solution:
**The logic followed here is : **

**First - second number = A; A × First number = Third number. **

(31, 26, 155) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 31 - 26 = 5; 5 × 31 = 155

(18, 12, 108) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 18 - 12 = 6; 6 × 18 = 108

Similarly,

(16, 9, 114) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 16 - 9 = 7; 7 × 16 = 112 ≠ 114 → Does not follow the pattern.

(19, 15, 84) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 19 - 15 = 4; 4 × 19 = 76 ≠ 84 → Does not follow the pattern.

**(17, 9, 136) ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] **17 - 9 = 8; 8 × 17 = 136 **→ Follows the pattern

(18, 10, 148) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244ecd6f96faf0c60df220f2c35ece997b93af8b3037b011a70fbf77702e4adb.png] 18 - 10 = 8; 8 × 18 = 144 ≠ 148 → Does not follow the pattern.

Hence, **(17, 9, 136)** is the correct answer.

questions.question: If it was Wednesday on 1st January 2020, then what day of the week was it on 28th February 2021?
questions.solution:
Given: 1st January 2020 was Wednesday,

 
 

 Leap Year
 2 odd days
 
 

 Ordinary Year
 1 odd day
 
 

 

then,

1st January 2021 = Wednesday + 2(2020 is leap year) = Friday.

Now,

Number of days between 1st January 2021 to 28th February 2021 = 58 days

⇒ 58 days = 58/7 = 8 weeks and 2 odd days.

So, 28th February 2021 = Friday + 2 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sunday"**.
